meta.title: Official recurring application policies
meta.disclaimer: The official university page publishes a recurring day-and-month application policy. GradWindow maps that policy to the next applicable cycle year; the year is not a cycle-specific date announced by the university.

recurringWindows.evidence: ULB's official 2026-2027 enrolment page and recurring submission policy publish these applicant-category periods. Specialised master's exceptions must be checked with the faculty.

recurringWindows.round: Belgian, European, EU-resident and Swiss applicants
